title: Interactive Hotel Stations (5 Core Stations)
acceptanceCriteria: Implements abstract HotelStation base class adhering to IHotelStation interface contract.
ReceptionDeskStation manages queue and check-in issuing keycards.
ProteinBarStation blends shakes over 3 seconds and outputs ProteinShake item.
SquatRackStation implements spotter mini-interaction with 5-second countdown gauge.
BedSuiteStation manages clean/dirty bed state and guest sleep cycle.
SaunaStation manages steam replenish and towel delivery.
